title: cs daily scratchpad - QBRs / renewals / support follow-ups
content:
Daily scratchpad - Mia Ramirez (CS)
Date: 2026-06-18
Last updated: 2026-06-19

Purpose: quick running list for QBR prep, upcoming renewals, and support follow-ups. Mostly notes to self; copy to account pages / Confluence once cleaned.

High-priority today
- Remedy Health (ARR ~$420k) - Renewal due 2026-07-05 (30 days).
  - Today: confirm decision maker list and alignment to new pricing tiers.
  - Action: send updated T&Cs + pricing comparison AS-IS vs. proposed changes by EOD 6/19. (Owner: Mia)
  - Reach out to Jordan to get the usage report for last 90d (token/latency spikes) - needed for QBR deck.
  - Open question: they asked about on-prem option; get private-deployments SME (Priya) on a 30-min call next week.

- NovaPay (ARR ~$150k) - QBR scheduled 2026-06-25, internal prep 6/22.
  - Deck outline: wins (latency improvements), incidents (Mar outage summary + remediation), cost optimization suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
  - Tasks: collect 2 customer success stories (payments infra + fraud detection). Ask Alex for the case snippet.
  - Ask Product: any roadmap items relevant to payments customers we can highlight? (Ping in slack #product-announce)

- AtlasRetail - Support follow-up / onboarding stuck
  - Open ticket JIRA-CS-987: embedding mismatch in recommendation pipeline - Patch in staging, needs validation.
  - Task: schedule 30m validation session with their engineering (contact: Lina Ortiz). Propose 6/20 or 6/22.
  - Note: They asked for longer-term batching guidance; prepare a short doc with target batch sizes per SKU volume.

Support queue (quick triage)
- P1: None active. Good.
- P2: Ticket JIRA-CS-1005 (Edge serving config) - waiting on logs from customer. Follow-up email by EOD.
- P3: multiple minor items - plan to triage with SRE tomorrow morning.

QBR prep checklist (generic template)
- Confirm date/time with customer and internal attendees
- Finalize 1-slide TL;DR (top-line outcomes + ask)
- Usage/latency/cost trends (last 90 days) - Jordan to provide graphs
- Incidents summary & RCA (if any) - SRE to provide blameless summary
- Product roadmap items relevant to account (ask PMs, include expected timelines)
- Business outcomes / ROI: compute cost per 1k inference, estimated savings with suggested changes
- Slides due internal review 2 days before customer meeting

Renewals tracker (next 60 days)
- Remedy Health - 2026-07-05 - Renewal + pricing discussion - high priority
- CloudMed - 2026-07-12 - up-sell opportunity for Dedicated pool
- FinBridge - 2026-07-20 - check legal on data residency clause

Notes to self / loose ideas
- Build a short "Renewal health" playbook: signals (usage decline, support volume, exec engagement) + actions per signal. Could standardize outreach cadence.
- For mid-size accounts, include a 1-page "cost optimization plan" that shows 3 levers: batching, quantization, route-to-cheaper-model policy. Use Redwood Optimize screenshots.
- Ask Growth for a templated email for renewal nudges (30/15/7 days out) - include renewal link and renewal FAQ.

Unresolved questions
- Remedy Health: who is the final approver in procurement? (Suspect: VP Finance - Daniela Park). Confirm before sending pricing.
- NovaPay: any compliance ask re: EU data that would block our standard contract? Flag to Legal if yes.

Comm & links
- Confluence: CONF-4321 (Customer QBR templates)
- Jira: JIRA-CS-987 (AtlasRetail), JIRA-CS-1005 (Edge config), JIRA-CS-998 (Remedy usage report)
- Slack: #cs-reminders, #cs-oncalls, DM Jordan Lee for usage graphs

Quick day plan (timeboxed)
- 09:00-09:30 - triage support queue / quick replies
- 09:30-11:00 - Remedy Health pricing email + attach usage summary
- 11:00-12:00 - sync with Jordan for NovaPay graphs + slide data handoff
- 13:00-14:00 - follow-up with AtlasRetail / propose validation times
- 14:00-15:00 - draft QBR TL;DR and slide skeleton
- 15:00-16:00 - touch base with Priya on private-deployments question for Remedy
- 16:00-17:00 - buffer: admin, slack follow-ups, update Confluence

Small wins to log for QBRs
- Latency improvement after kernel update (serving-runtime) - 6% avg token latency improvement for x-class models (note: attribute to release 2026-05-30).
- Reduced cost for NovaPay by 12% after batching changes implemented in May.

End of notes.

(If anything from this doc needs to be shared externally, clean up and move to customer page or Confluence. This is intentionally rough.)
